title: Mitochondrial Modulation as a Therapeutic Entry Point in Neurodegeneration.
intervention: mitochondrial modulation (antioxidants, NAD+ augmentation, mitochondrial genome engineering, targeted delivery, organelle transfer)

outcomes.name: efficacy of broadly acting mitochondrial interventions in sporadic disease
outcomes.effect_text: broadly acting interventions have repeatedly failed in sporadic disease

outcomes.name: translational signal for targeted mitochondrial modulation
outcomes.effect_text: strongest translational signals arise where mitochondrial dysfunction is genetically anchored and pathway-proximal
